plugins.name: lode
plugins.description: [code] Worklode: worktree-bound task pickup for agents. Slash commands /lode:next|resume|done|block|status wrap the lode CLI to claim a ready task, create its worktree under .worktrees/, bind the lease, and mark it done/blocked. /lode:spec-coverage finds specs no plan covers and seeds a planning task for each. Lifecycle hooks ship with the CLI, not here: `lode install` writes them per repo (Claude Code settings plus the git pre-commit heartbeat), so they stay versioned with the binary.
